mapper.select: WITH TripStats AS ( SELECT t.id AS trip_id, t.trip_name, t.start_date, t.end_date, t.total_target_amount, COALESCE(SUM(tr.amount), 0) AS total_spent FROM trips t LEFT JOIN transactions tr ON t.id = tr.trip_id AND tr.is_deleted = 0 WHERE t.id = #{tripId} AND t.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY t.id, t.trip_name, t.start_date, t.end_date ) SELECT ts.trip_id, ts.trip_name, ts.start_date, ts.end_date, (ts.total_target_amount - ts.total_spent) AS total_remaining_fund, tc.id AS id, c.country_name, tc.target_budget, COALESCE(SUM(tr.amount), 0) AS spent_amount, tc.arrival_date, tc.departure_date, DATEDIFF(tc.departure_date, tc.arrival_date) + 1 AS total_days, CASE WHEN CURRENT_DATE < tc.arrival_date THEN 0 WHEN CURRENT_DATE > tc.departure_date THEN DATEDIFF(tc.departure_date, tc.arrival_date) + 1 ELSE DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, tc.arrival_date) END AS passed_days FROM TripStats ts JOIN trip_countries tc ON ts.trip_id = tc.trip_id JOIN countries c ON tc.country_id = c.id LEFT JOIN transactions tr ON tc.id = tr.trip_country_id AND tr.is_deleted = 0 WHERE tc.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY ts.trip_id, ts.trip_name, ts.start_date, ts.end_date, tc.id, c.country_name, tc.target_budget, tc.arrival_date, tc.departure_date, ts.total_target_amount, ts.total_spent

WITH CountryStats AS ( SELECT tc.id AS trip_country_id, c.country_name, tc.target_budget, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(pe.direct_amount) FROM pre_expenses pe WHERE pe.trip_country_id = tc.id AND pe.is_deleted = 0), 0) AS pre_expense_total, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(tr.amount) FROM transactions tr WHERE tr.trip_country_id = tc.id AND tr.is_pre_expense = 0 AND tr.is_deleted = 0), 0) AS travel_expense_total FROM trip_countries tc JOIN countries c ON tc.country_id = c.id WHERE tc.trip_id = #{tripId} AND tc.is_deleted = 0 ), CategoryStats AS ( SELECT tc.id AS trip_country_id, sc.category_name, COALESCE(SUM(tr.amount), 0) AS amount, (COALESCE(SUM(tr.amount), 0) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE trip_country_id = tc.id AND is_pre_expense = 0 AND is_deleted = 0), 0) * 100) AS percentage FROM trip_countries tc LEFT JOIN transactions tr ON tc.id = tr.trip_country_id AND tr.is_pre_expense = 0 AND tr.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN spending_categories sc ON tr.category_id = sc.id WHERE tc.trip_id = #{tripId} AND tc.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY tc.id, sc.category_name ) SELECT cs.trip_country_id, cs.country_name, cs.target_budget, cs.pre_expense_total, cs.travel_expense_total, cats.category_name, cats.amount, cats.percentage FROM CountryStats cs LEFT JOIN CategoryStats cats ON cs.trip_country_id = cats.trip_country_id

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip_budget_recommendations ( trip_country_id, traveler_count, travel_style, recommended_airfare_amount, recommended_lodging_amount, recommended_activity_amount, recommended_transport_amount, recommended_food_amount, recommended_other_amount, ai_reason, ai_model ) VALUES ( #{tripCountryId}, #{travelerCount}, #{travelStyle}, #{airfareAmount}, #{lodgingAmount}, #{activityAmount}, #{transportAmount}, #{foodAmount}, #{otherAmount}, #{aiReason}, #{aiModel} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE traveler_count = VALUES(traveler_count), travel_style = VALUES(travel_style), recommended_airfare_amount = VALUES(recommended_airfare_amount), recommended_lodging_amount = VALUES(recommended_lodging_amount), recommended_activity_amount = VALUES(recommended_activity_amount), recommended_transport_amount = VALUES(recommended_transport_amount), recommended_food_amount = VALUES(recommended_food_amount), recommended_other_amount = VALUES(recommended_other_amount), ai_reason = VALUES(ai_reason), ai_model = VALUES(ai_model), confirmed_airfare_amount = NULL, confirmed_lodging_amount = NULL, confirmed_activity_amount = NULL, confirmed_transport_amount = NULL, confirmed_food_amount = NULL, confirmed_other_amount = NULL, is_confirmed = 0
mapper.select: SELECT tc.id AS tripCountryId, c.country_name, cur.currency_code, tc.arrival_date, tc.departure_date, br.recommended_airfare_amount, br.recommended_lodging_amount, br.recommended_activity_amount, br.recommended_transport_amount, br.recommended_food_amount, br.recommended_other_amount, br.confirmed_airfare_amount, br.confirmed_lodging_amount, br.confirmed_activity_amount, br.confirmed_transport_amount, br.confirmed_food_amount, br.confirmed_other_amount, br.ai_reason, br.is_confirmed FROM trip_countries tc INNER JOIN countries c ON c.id = tc.country_id INNER JOIN currencies cur ON cur.id = c.currency_id LEFT JOIN trip_budget_recommendations br ON br.trip_country_id = tc.id WHERE tc.trip_id = #{tripId} AND tc.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY tc.display_order ASC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(tcb.krw_estimated_amount), 0) FROM wallet w JOIN wallet_travel_card wtc ON wtc.wallet_id = w.id AND wtc.status = 'LINKED' JOIN travel_card_balance tcb ON tcb.wallet_travel_card_id = wtc.id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} AND w.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN wl.direction = 'IN' THEN wl.amount WHEN wl.direction = 'OUT' THEN -wl.amount ELSE 0 END ), 0) FROM wallet_ledger wl JOIN wallet w ON wl.wallet_id = w.id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} AND w.status = 'ACTIVE' AND wl.transaction_type NOT IN ('ADJUST', 'CARD_TOPUP', 'EXCHANGE_SELL') AND wl.trip_id = ( SELECT id FROM trips WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status IN ('PLANNING', 'TRAVELING', 'ENDED') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND DATE_FORMAT(wl.created_at, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m')

SELECT COALESCE(SUM( COALESCE(br.confirmed_airfare_amount, br.recommended_airfare_amount, 0) + COALESCE(br.confirmed_lodging_amount, br.recommended_lodging_amount, 0) ), 0) FROM trip_countries tc LEFT JOIN trip_budget_recommendations br ON br.trip_country_id = tc.id WHERE tc.trip_id = #{tripId} AND tc.is_deleted = 0

mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS transactionId, t.trip_id, c.country_name, sc.category_name, t.merchant_name, t.amount, t.original_amount, t.applied_exchange_rate, cur.symbol AS currencySymbol, t.transaction_date, t.transaction_type FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN trip_countries tc ON t.trip_country_id = tc.id LEFT JOIN countries c ON tc.country_id = c.id LEFT JOIN spending_categories sc ON t.category_id = sc.id LEFT JOIN currencies cur ON t.currency_id = cur.id WHERE t.trip_id = #{tripId} AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.transaction_type = 'WITHDRAWAL' AND (#{countryId} IS NULL OR t.trip_country_id = #{countryId}) AND (#{categoryName} IS NULL OR sc.category_name = #{categoryName}) ORDER BY t.transaction_date DESC
